sources.title: Travel Convenience Privilege: Iran
sources.publisher: Identification Services Bureau, Macao SAR Government
sources.officialityEvidence: This live DSI API record is returned by the Macao SAR Government's current Travel Convenience Privilege service when its Macao SAR Passport selection is queried for Iran. It identifies Iran, marks visaFree 1, visaOnArrival 0 and evisa 0, and gives a 21-day maximum stay.

sources.title: Travel Convenience Privilege: Pakistan
sources.publisher: Identification Services Bureau, Macao SAR Government
sources.officialityEvidence: This live DSI API record is returned by the Macao SAR Government's current Travel Convenience Privilege service when its Macao SAR Passport selection is queried for Pakistan. It identifies Pakistan, marks visa-free and visa-on-arrival false, marks evisa 1, and links to Pakistan's official online visa service.

sources.title: Travel Convenience Privilege
sources.publisher: Identification Services Bureau, Macao SAR Government
sources.officialityEvidence: DSI's live official service identifies the selected document as the Macao SAR Passport and uses its current data API for country-specific visa-free, arrival-visa and eVisa information. The service is used only for direct country records, never as an omission-based residual rule.

sources.title: Visa Categories
sources.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration & Passports, Ministry of Interior, Government of Pakistan
sources.officialityEvidence: Pakistan's current Directorate General of Immigration & Passports visa-policy page defines its renamed Visa in Your Inbox route. Combined with DSI's direct Macao-passport Pakistan record, it establishes that the listed electronic authorization is obtained before travel rather than at the border.
sources.supportingExcerpt: the applicant will apply online from his/her home country and will get electronic authorization to travel.

policies.title: Macao SAR ordinary passports: Iran visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Macao's current passport-specific DSI record directly identifies Iran as visa-free for the Macao SAR Passport, with a maximum stay of 21 days.
conditions: Applies only to the ordinary Macao SAR Passport selected in DSI's live Travel Convenience Privilege service.
The direct DSI record states a maximum stay of 21 days and marks visa-on-arrival and eVisa false.
Visitor purpose, passport validity, admission, security, itinerary, transit, residence, work and all non-ordinary document routes remain outside this policy.

policies.title: Macao SAR ordinary passports: Pakistan electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Macao's current passport-specific DSI record maps Pakistan to eVisa. Pakistan's current immigration authority confirms applicants apply online from their home country and receive electronic authorization to travel before arrival.
conditions: Applies only to the ordinary Macao SAR Passport selected in DSI's live Travel Convenience Privilege service.
Apply online from the home country and receive electronic authorization before travel; show it to immigration for passport stamping on arrival.
The policy does not establish business, work, residence, pilgrimage, diplomatic, official, service, group-tour, special-document or final-admission treatment.

application.label: Pakistan Online Visa System
steps: Apply through Pakistan's official online visa system from the home country.
Receive the electronic authorization to travel before departure.
Present the authorization to immigration for passport stamping on arrival.

DSI directly maps the ordinary Macao SAR Passport to Pakistan eVisa, and Pakistan's immigration authority confirms electronic authorization before travel.
